objective_value: <float> Total cost combining lock-mode ship delays, transshipment-mode ship delays, and transshipment penalties.
modes: <dict, key: '{ship}'> Mode chosen for each ship, with 1 indicating transshipment at a berth and 0 indicating passage through the lock.
completion_times: <dict, key: '{ship}'> Departure time of each ship.
lockage_assignments: <dict, key: '{ship}'> Index of the lockage that transfers each lock-mode ship.
lockage_completion_times: <dict, key: '{lockage}'> Completion time of each used lockage.

{ship}.berth: <int> Berth at which the transshipment-mode ship is served.
{ship}.order: <int> Service order position of the ship at its assigned berth.
